svg.title: Grading a real answer: right move, wrong reason
svg.desc: A chess diagram, White to move. The model played the correct Qxe5+ and gave the correct line, earning 55 of 55 points for move and line, but named the wrong motif and claimed the black queen was undefended when Black simply recaptures with the king. The real idea is trading queens so the d-pawn promotes. The rubric scores it 55 of 100, where a move-only benchmark would give 100.

g.text: 1. Qxe5+ Kxe5 2. d7, and it queens
(the real idea: trade queens, win the race)
undefended and you have a check,
it is a promotion race, not a fork
false claim: Black just recaptures, Kxe5
